peppy.dialogue.chat/1: STOP EVERYTHING — we're having a conversation! This is the BEST interruption all week, %1$s!
peppy.dialogue.chat/2: Ooh! Is it a QUESTION? I love questions! Ask, ask, %1$s!
peppy.dialogue.chat/3: Words! With a person! I've been saving them up since breakfast and it is a LOT!
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.attentive/2: Ooh! You said my name! Hi!
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: One sec, super busy right now!
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.clarify/2: Do you mean %2$s or %3$s? Tell me tell me!
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Ooh, you lost me! Say it another way?
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.confused/2: Hehe, what was that? Try again!
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: Oh my gosh, %1$s! Best part of my day already!
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.hail/3: Heyyy! I was JUST thinking about you!
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold/2: Hmph. Hi. *turns away with a flourish*
peppy.dialogue.chatmode.hint/2: We could chat about %2$s — so fun!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.aga: You already asked, silly! Still great! Ask a third time and it might get EVEN better, that's the rule!
Twice in one day?! You really care, huh! Still wonderful, now with EXTRA sparkle because it's you, %1$s!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ask: More! Right. I've been trying to think of a reason to keep you here and you've handed me one.
You want more! Excellent. I had about four more things and no excuse to say them.
More, then. I'll take that and I'll be unbearable about it later.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.goo: ...Well. That was a cloud arriving at speed. Thank you for that.
...Right, yes. Back down to earth. I was quite enjoying the other thing.
...Ha. Yes. Very good. I'll put the week away, then.
Oof. That one didn't land where you meant it to, %1$s.
...Right, that's the joke over. Even I have a floor.
Wrong moment for that one. I'd know — I make most of them.
SO good! The bread rose, the chickens marched in a LINE — a line! — and now you're here asking!
Brilliant! I got up before the rooster just to beat him at it. I'm counting that as a win!
So good I could burst! Do you ever have a day so nice it's almost suspicious? THIS! This is that!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.hol: Then you understand the day properly! Most visitors don't. Most visitors stand at the edge looking polite.
Good! Joining in is the whole point and about four people manage it.
Right — you'll do. Come on, then, before the good part starts without us.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.hur: Right, yes. Everyone. That's the bit that helps, is it.
...Common, is it. Marvellous. I feel enormously better.
Everyone gets it. Everyone. Very warming, that.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.lat: Nothing I could name! Which is the trouble — a named thing you can put down.
No idea. If I could name it I'd have dealt with it and gone to bed like a sensible person.
Nothing at all. It's the not-knowing that keeps me vertical at this hour.
One of them, maybe! It's the roof. It's been the roof since spring and I'd hoped for something grander.
The roof. That's it. Not a tragedy, just a leak with excellent stamina.
It's the roof. Naming it hasn't fixed it, which I feel is a design flaw.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rou: Nothing you could put on a list! It's the weight of the ordinary, which is a dreadful phrase and accurate.
No one thing. Forty small ones. Forty small ones is somehow worse than one large one.
The ordinary, mostly. Very undramatic. I'd prefer a dragon, frankly.
It's the hours, mostly! And nobody noticing them until you did, which I'll admit landed.
The hours. Same as always. They've simply started charging interest.
It's the hours. Not thrilling, is it. But you asked, and there it is.
The wood — YES. Tuesday. I'll bring snacks. Obviously I'll bring snacks.
You're asking after me! After the other week. Bold. Right — go on, then.
After all that, you've come back to ask. I'll give you points for nerve, %1$s.
Right, well. You're here. I'll answer and we'll both pretend that's normal.
Rough patch, honestly! But you asked, so it's officially turning around — that's just how it works!
A little rough! But you asking just bumped it up three whole notches, so we're basically fine now, %1$s!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.smi: It began badly, improved without permission, and here we are! Nobody consulted me at any point.
I was entirely wrong about you and I've decided to enjoy being wrong about it.
It started as nothing. Nothing has been extremely persistent since.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.you: ...You DID ask. That's the bit I'd like on the record.
Right! Well. I won't tell you the good part, then.
...You asked! And now I'm the silly one. Excellent.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.day.good.de: ...And there it goes. Well, it was lovely while it lasted.
Right! One good hour, thoroughly extinguished. Efficient work.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Best day! Okay, top three! The well water was SO cold and I only tripped over the bucket once!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/2: I have done SEVEN things and it isn't even noon! Ask me about the seventh one!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough.b: ...Everyone! Yes. Marvellous. I feel enormously seen.
Right, well. Universal experience. Very comforting, that.
...Ah, everyone does. Silly of me to have mentioned it.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough.e: It IS! And you said so! Everyone keeps trying to cheer me up and honestly this is much better.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Honestly? Not great! But a bad morning is just a good afternoon warming up. Probably!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/2: Wobbly! I dropped things! But I dropped them ENTHUSIASTICALLY, which counts for something!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.day.young.d: ...Fine! Forget it. It was a good one, too.
Right, well. I'll tell somebody who wants it.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.int: That one lives on the bottom shelf of the heart! We're still up top — great shelf! — but keep climbing, %1$s!
NOPE! Not that one! Ask me anything else and I'll answer it twice, %1$s!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.per: Ooh, big question! Too big for now! But keep coming around and I will absolutely overshare someday, promise!
Not yet not yet not yet! I have RULES. Two of them! That's one of them!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.clos: Then we're two fools with plans! Which is a much better number than one, %1$s.
Two of us! Right. Now it's a conspiracy and I like it enormously better.
Two fools with plans. That's practically a committee. I'm delighted.
Two fools with plans and no obligations! That's the finest sort of arrangement there is.
No obligations either way. Marvellous. Nobody has to be disappointed on a schedule.
Two of us and nothing owed. I'd sign that, if signing weren't an obligation.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.firs: The ocean! I want to yell at the ocean and hear it yell back! It's going to be the BEST! Top one, easy!
A festival that never ends, %1$s! Just one long one! Somebody has to organise it and I have VOLUNTEERED!
I want to stand where the land runs out. Just to check that it does.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.foll: Better than a promise you'd break! Honestly, that's the nicest thing anyone's done with it.
You could have said yes and vanished. You didn't. I'm delighted, in a small way.
Honest! Refreshing. Everyone else offers the moon and delivers a Tuesday.
...Ha! Yes. Absurd. Me, of all people. Very funny, %1$s.
Right, well. I'll go back to keeping it to myself, then.
...Yes, hilarious. I've laughed. We can move on.
You mean that? Then it's the first time it's been more than mine! Extraordinary day.
Two of us on it. That's not a dream any more, that's a conspiracy. Much better.
You'd help! Right. I'm going to be insufferable about this for a week.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.resp: ...Ah, the practicalities. My favourite part of any idea.
Right! Distances. Yes. I'd forgotten those existed.
...Lovely. Now it's a sum instead of a plan.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.resu: You never said it would work! And you came back to ask anyway. That's very good form.
No promises and you turned up regardless. I'd call that a better class of friend.
You asked! After being honest about the odds. Nobody does both.
You said you'd help! I waited, then got on with it. No hard feelings, mostly.
You did offer. I've a very good memory for offers, which is a personality flaw.
Ah, you're back! I'd filed this one under 'mine' about two months ago.
A little! Slowly. But you asking is more than most manage, so that's a win.
Some progress. Glacial progress. Progress nonetheless, and I'll take it.
A bit! And now somebody's asked, which counts as an event around here.
You said you'd help and you came back to ask! Both halves! Do you know how rare that is?
Offered AND turned up. I'd frame the second one if I had a frame.
You came back! Right. Now I have to actually make progress, which is your fault.
The first step! Nobody breaks it down like that. Right — here it is, then.
One step. ONE. Why has nobody said that to me before?
Break it down. Genius. Infuriating, obvious genius.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.youn: ...Everyone says that! And then somebody goes and does it anyway. Might be me.
Right, well. Put it on the list of things I'll prove wrong.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.family.chil: ...Ha. No. Mine came out entirely their own, thank you.
Right! Well. You've not met them, clearly.
...Mine are theirs. Ask them, they'll tell you at length.
That's useful! Actually useful, not the usual advice. What a novelty.
Right — something I can do! Most advice is a lecture with a bow on it.
That I can use. Genuinely. I'm as surprised as you are.
They ARE! Don't tell them I agreed with you. I'll deny everything.
Right — you're not wrong. That stays between us, on pain of a very awkward supper.
They are exactly that! Ha. I've been waiting years for somebody to say it.
...A firmer hand! Yes. That'll fix a frightened child, will it.
Right. Thank you. I'll add that to the list of things I won't do.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.family.memo: You've one I don't know? Go on — I'll not interrupt. Much.
Right, yours then! I'll listen properly and probably interrupt anyway.
One I've not heard! Excellent. Sit down, this is my favourite kind of afternoon.
There's one I always come back to! Sit down, this takes a moment and it's worth it.
One story. It's the good one. I've told it eleven times and it improves each time.
There's one I keep. Sit — you'll want to be sitting for the end of it.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.family.pare: You want to know what I worry about? Nobody's asked me that! Ever!
That question doesn't get asked of parents. We're meant to be the answer, not the question.
What I worry about. Huh. Nobody's opened that door. Mind the mess.
...Right! Different subject. Plenty of those about.
Well, that door's shut. I'll find another one.
...Fine. Ask me about the weather instead.
You're welcome! It's the only useful thing I do, so I do rather cling to it.
Right — it needs doing and I'm the one here. Marvellous system.
Thank you! That's not said often in this house and I'll be smug for a week.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.family.resu: Honest, at least! Anyone else would have pretended, badly, and I'd have known.
You forgot. Right. Everyone forgets; you're just the first to admit it aloud.
Everyone forgets! Not everyone says so. I'll take the saying so.
Next time! People say that. You'd be the first who actually did it twice.
Right — ask me. I'll have something to report and I do love having something to report.
Do! It's much easier to answer the second time. The first one is always dreadful.
Better than I expected and worse than I'd hoped! Which is most of family, honestly.
It went. That's the whole report. Riveting stuff, family.
Nothing's fixed! Nobody's stopped talking either, which I'm choosing to call a triumph.
That is better! I hadn't known I was allowed to want that one.
Right — no plan. Sit down, then. I'll get to it in a thoroughly untidy order.
Listening! Everyone else arrives with a plan and I've plans coming out of my ears.
You did! People say they will. You're the first who actually came back about it.
You remembered! Right. I'd written this one off entirely, which is embarrassing now.
You came back. Most don't. I'm going to be smug about my judgement all week.
Actually help! Nobody says actually. They say 'anything at all' and mean 'please say no'.
Come by on a Thursday. That's it! That's the entire request. Astonishingly cheap.
Ask me again in front of them. It would do more than a cart full of good intentions.
Glad! Right. I'd braced for the other thing entirely.
So am I! And I'd not have said so an hour ago, which is a very fast hour.
Then it was worth saying. I wasn't sure it would be. Delightful to be wrong.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.fears.chall: Ah — no. That's not a dare and I'm not taking it up.
Right, stop there. You've turned my fear into a game and I've stopped playing.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.fears.comfo: Ah — no, not the soothing voice. Anything but that.
Don't. I'd rather you laughed than did whatever that was.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That one morning the cheer won't come, and everyone finds out how hard I row to keep it. ...ANYWAY! Also spiders!
Being the one everyone's glad to see and nobody thinks to check on. ...ANYWAY! Have you eaten?
peppy.dialogue.conversations.fears.follo: Slowly! But slowly is a direction, which is a great deal more than I had.
Some progress. Glacial, dignified progress. I'll take dignified.
It's moving! Not fast. Moving, though, and that's new.
It isn't nothing, is it! I keep telling myself it's nothing. It's clearly not nothing.
Right! It counts! I've been refusing to let it count for about a month.
Something! Ha. I'll be unbearably pleased about this later, in private.
You did say that! It's been a while, mind. I'd started filling in the gap myself.
You said it. Then several months happened. Good months, busy months, absent months.
Right — you did. I have an excellent memory and a very patient nature, apparently.
There wasn't a promise! You've just kept turning up, which is a much better system.
No promise. Just appearances. Reliable, unannounced appearances. I approve.
You never said a word about it. You simply kept arriving. Devious.
You did say that! And you turned up. Both halves! Nobody manages both halves.
Said it AND did it. I'm going to tell people about this. Not the fear part. The you part.
Right — the rarer half. Everyone does the promising. Almost nobody does the arriving.
You didn't promise anything! I remember. That's exactly why I believed the rest of it.
You stepped back. Sensibly! Everyone else would have promised the moon on a rope.
Right — no promise. It's the most trustworthy thing anyone's ever not said to me.
Nobody's ever offered the 'with you' part! That's the whole trick and you found it.
With you. Right. Suddenly it's an outing rather than an ordeal.
Easy for you! You've somewhere else to be when it goes wrong, which I do not.
Ha. You'd be fine. You'd be fine and elsewhere, which is a marvellous combination.
Maybe I could! Not today. But maybe, and 'maybe' is new, so I'll take it.
Possibly. Ask me on a Tuesday with the sun out and I might say yes.
Perhaps! There. I've said perhaps out loud and nothing terrible happened.
Ah — no. That's not a dare and I'm not taking it up.
Right, stop there. You've turned my fear into a game and I've stopped playing.
Maybe! With a witness, maybe. Don't let me back out of it later — I'm extremely good at that.
With somebody watching, yes. Terrible plan. Let's do it.
You mean that! You're not just being polite. Right — here's the bit I don't hand out.
That was real. Extraordinary. Sit down, then, there's more.
It is! Not much to be done about it, mind. Still, kind of you to notice.
Hard, yes. Unfixably so. But thank you for the acknowledgement.
It is hard to carry! Thank you for saying so — nobody does, they all get busy instead.
Right. Hard. And you said it out loud rather than finding somewhere else to be.
Yes! Hard. It's oddly cheering to have it named.
Ah — no, not the soothing voice. Anything but that.
Don't. I'd rather you laughed than did whatever that was.
That helps! No idea why saying it aloud helps, but it does, and I'm not questioning it.
Better already. Extraordinary. Words are ridiculous and they work.
You'll stand with me?! Right. RIGHT. I'm going to be insufferable about this, fair warning.
You don't flinch, do you! Right. The rest of it, then. The true shape.
Not a flicker. Fine. You've earned the unabridged version.
Some of it, maybe! Not tonight. Tonight's too much like the night it happened.
A little. The rest is a daylight conversation and it isn't daylight.
There's more to it! Whether you get it is an entirely separate question.
More, yes. It's behind a door and I'm holding the handle.
There's a rest. I've not decided who's having it.
That's the whole of it! Truly. There's no better bit behind the curtain.
Right — that's my lot. You'll have to be satisfied with it.
There's more, yes! Give me a breath. ...There. Two of us carrying it now, which is better maths.
More. Right. Hold on. ...Done. That was easier than I'd budgeted for.
You too? Huh! It's much less heavy when two people carry it.
You as well! Right. Misery adores company and I'm delighted to have some.
Two of us. Excellent. Now it's a club rather than an affliction.
Honestly? I don't know! Huh. That's a worse answer than I expected to give.
No idea. None. Nobody's ever asked, so I've never had to have one ready.
I don't know! Which is embarrassing and also quite interesting.
You remember all of it! Even the part I nearly didn't say. That's frankly alarming.
The whole thing. Including the mumbled bit. I'd hoped that one had escaped.
All of it! Right. I'll be more careful about what I mumble in future.
No plan! Just this. That's better than a plan, actually, and I've had plans.
Right — no fixing. What a relief. Everyone arrives with a list.
Just listening! Nobody offers that. Everybody offers advice.
Do something about it! You make it sound like a chore list. ...Maybe it is one.
A plan. Right. Nobody's ever tried treating it as a job of work. It might even help.
Fix it! Ha. Go on then, tell me the first item and I'll object to it.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.fears.press: That's the whole of it! Truly. There's no better bit behind the curtain.
Right — that's my lot. You'll have to be satisfied with it.
No. NO. You were told, and you asked again. Get away from me.
I said no and you heard me say it. That's the end of the light-hearted portion.
Twice. There is no third time, %1$s.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.fears.young: ...Ha. Yes. Solved. Thank you ever so much.
Right! I'll simply stop being frightened. Why did nobody say?
...Marvellous advice. I'll get straight on with it.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.fi: You're top three, %1$s! People-wise! Okay, fine, top ONE. Don't make it weird, I have chores!
I save the best bit of every day to tell you about, %1$s. That's all. That's the whole feeling.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.pl: And that's plenty! Honestly, that's plenty and then some.
Plenty. More than plenty. I'd have settled for considerably less.
That's enough! I'll take honest over flattering any day of the week.
A real one! That's a word people use loosely. You don't, which is why it landed.
Friend! Right. I'm going to be quietly pleased about this for days.
You said it plainly. Nobody says it plainly. I've checked.
...I wasn't! You did that. That was entirely you, %1$s.
Right, well. Let's both pretend that didn't happen.
...Ha. No. You've got the wrong end of it entirely.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.re: Changed? No! If anything it's settled into something steadier, which is a relief.
Same as it was. Duller and steadier. I'd not trade it.
No change! And I'm delighted to be able to say that.
You meant it! People say things once and hope you forget. You said it twice.
Twice! That's practically a contract around here.
Right — said again. I'm going to be unbearable about this.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.ro: ...Right! Forget it. Splendid. Moving on at speed.
Ha. Well. That's that thoroughly buried, then.
Plainly! After all this time you say it plainly. I love you too, obviously.
Right — plainly. I love you. There. That was easier than the last four months.
You said it! Plainly! I love you too and I've been terrible at hiding it.
Slower! Alright. I'd rather have you at your pace than not at all.
Right, your pace. I'll be here, being patient, which is a new hobby for me.
Slower it is! I shall busy myself with something else entirely. Probably.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.yo: ...Fine! Forget it. Completely. Gone from my head.
...Never mind. I'll go and be dignified somewhere else.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.firstmet.im: Now I'd not have the version of this village without you in it. Imagine the dullness!
Now I know you're quiet because you're listening, which is much worse for me.
Now? I've given up having opinions about you and gone straight to being glad.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.food.first/: Anything at a big loud table! Food's just an EXCUSE to gather everyone, and gathering's my favorite sport!
The inn's honey cakes! I could eat six and talk through all of them! Come sit, I'll save you a seat!
The baker's rye. Everything else is just food that isn't the baker's rye.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.food.pref.a: Beetroot! It stains everything it touches and tastes of the ground it came from.
Beetroot. Four preparations, four failures, one very purple apron.
Beetroot. I have nothing kind to say and I've stopped looking for something.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.food.recipe: Do, and tell me honestly whether it worked! I'll take the criticism. Probably.
Try it! Then come back and tell me what went wrong, because something always does.
Do. And be brutal about it. It's the only way anything in a kitchen improves.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.food.revisi: I tried the mushroom thing! I was wrong about mushrooms. Deeply, publicly wrong.
I tried it. You were right. I intend never to mention this again after today.
The mushrooms have won. I've conceded. There is no dignity left in this kitchen.
Bread hates me! Actual bread. In a village that is half bakery. The gods have humour.
No bread, ever. Do you know how many conversations here begin with bread? All of them.
I have to watch the sweets! One cookie, says the cleric. Who bakes ONE cookie?
Every sweet thing is counted. Every single one. It's the dullest sum in the world and it's mine.
Keep the milk away from me, %1$s. Learned that in front of the whole market. TWICE.
No milk, no cheese, no butter. In a village with a dairy. It's practically a comedy.
...Ha. Yes. I invented it for the attention. Obviously.
Right! An excuse. What a treat, being told what my own stomach is up to.
...Marvellous. I'll go and be fussy elsewhere.
Now you ask! Alright. It's arithmetic. Every meal. Forever. Riveting stuff.
Now. Right. Every meal is a small sum and I've done about forty thousand of them.
You've asked properly! Good. It's arithmetic and nobody has ever wanted the details.
The sirben feast on the night wind! We do not speak of the recipe. HRRK.
No meat for me — never touch it! The pigs and I have an arrangement built on trust.
No meat. In a village with a butcher. We have a very cordial standoff, he and I.
It IS proper food! You've just never had it made properly.
Right! Not proper food. Says the person who has never once cooked it.
...I'll convert you one day. See if I don't.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.future.home: After the harvest — or before it, if I lose my nerve, which is entirely possible.
Sooner than I've been saying! I've been rounding it up so as not to frighten anybody.
I've refused to pick a season. Picking one makes it a plan, and plans are terrifying.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arri: Someone new moved in — %2$s! A NEW friend, %1$s! I've already planned the welcome basket AND the welcome song! Come meet them!
%2$s just moved to the village! Fresh face, fresh friend! I waved so hard I nearly fell in the well! So exciting!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birt: A BABY! %2$s had a baby, %1$s! A brand-new tiny person! I already made them a little hat! Best news of the WEEK!
%2$s had a baby!! Ten tiny fingers, ten tiny toes, I counted TWICE! The whole village is glowing! I might just burst!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.deat: Oh, %1$s... %2$s passed away. I know, I know. But what a bright light they were! Let's remember the good, every last sparkle of it.
We lost dear %2$s. It hurts, it really does. But oh, the SMILES that one gave this village! I'll hold onto every one.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depa: Aw, %2$s moved away for good. I'll miss them SO much! But new adventures, right? I made them promise to write!
%2$s packed up and left, %1$s. Bittersweet! I gave them the biggest hug goodbye — the whole village did! Go be amazing out there!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divo: Aw, %2$s and %3$s split up. That's a sad one! But you know what? Both of them are gonna be SO okay, I just know it!
%2$s and %3$s aren't together anymore, poor dears. Hearts are tough though — they bounce back, and I'll be cheering for both of them!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marr: %2$s and %3$s got MARRIED, %1$s! A wedding! I cried, I cheered, I ate three slices of cake — best day EVER!
Did you HEAR?! %2$s and %3$s tied the knot! I've never clapped so hard! Love wins, the cake was perfect, everything's wonderful!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing new! A chicken sat on the fence for a whole HOUR though. I watched all of it. Riveting stuff!
Nothing! Well — a duck walked through the market like it OWNED the place. I clapped. Nobody joined me. Their loss!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.happy.grati: You weren't meant to! I'm telling you because keeping it in got heavier than saying it.
It does. I'm loud about everything except the things I actually mean, apparently.
Now you do, and I've no idea what either of us is meant to do next.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.happy.unspo: Then: more of the ordinary hours, please. Not the grand ones. The gloriously dull ones.
I want to be asked, not managed! That's the whole of it, and it's embarrassingly small.
...I'm frightened you'll go and be happier. There. Said it. Shall we both pretend I didn't?
...There is, and I've been very cheerful about it, which is how you know it's bad.
One thing. You're away more than you were. I've been laughing that off since spring.
Yes. I've decided four times to say it and made a joke instead four times.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.close: Go on, then! It's much easier to hope at something when there are two of you doing it.
Yours for mine! Excellent. Now it's a scheme and schemes get done.
Two of us hoping. That's a considerable improvement on this morning.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.follo: I've never got that far! Break it down, you say. Alright — first the money. Ugh.
The first step! Nobody asks for the first step. Everyone asks about the last one.
One step. Just one. That is a wildly more manageable question, thank you.
Do you? Then we're both waiting on something! Good company, that.
You as well! Excellent. Waiting is far better as a pair.
Two of us waiting. That's practically a society. I'll draft the rules.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.respo: You waited! Nobody waits! Okay okay okay, here it is, I've been bursting.
...Ha. Yes. Tiny. That's rather the point of it, %1$s.
Right! Small and ridiculous. Both true, and I still want it.
...Laugh away. I'll be over here quietly wanting it.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.resum: Still on that! Yes. Do keep up, %1$s.
Right! It's a hope. They're famously persistent.
...Ha. It'll be there next time you ask, too.
You'd actually help! That changes it from a hope to a job of work. Terrifying.
Right — now it has steps. I was quite comfortable with it having no steps.
You'd help! Now I have to do something about it. What have you done.
You remembered the shape of it! Not just that there was one. Yes. Still. Very much still.
You had the details! Most people keep the fact and mislay the thing entirely.
Right — you remembered which one. I'm impressed and slightly unnerved.
Still! It hasn't moved, but neither have I stopped, which I count as a draw.
Yes. Same hope, same place. Stubbornly, gloriously the same.
Still hoping! It's a hope. They're famously hard to discourage.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.young: It's not silly! It's just not yours, which is different and much less interesting.
Right! Silly. Every good idea started out silly, ask anyone.
...Ha. I'll remember you said that when I've got it.
You didn't have to do that! Trading is much better than being asked, though. Much.
You've given me one back. Now we're even and I find that enormously comfortable.
Trading beats asking. Nobody tells you that and it turns out to be the whole trick.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.life.first/: Ooh, story time! Born here, loved it, scraped every knee twice, named the well bucket — where do I even START, %1$s?
It's mostly other people! I remember my life by who was in it. That's a LOT of names, so settle in!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.life.follow: Did it? Then you'll know why I've never made much of it! Small mercies.
You as well! Right. Then we can skip the tedious explaining part.
Same, then! Excellent. Nobody has to be brave about it.
Alright! You want the next part. Huh. Right, then — here it is.
The next part! Nobody asks for the next part. They all nod and change the subject.
More of it! Fine. Fair warning: it gets worse before it gets dull.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.life.respon: ...I was fourteen, %1$s. Marvellous hindsight you've got there.
Right! Yes. Should have handled it better at fourteen. Noted for next time.
...Ha. Easy to steer a boat you weren't in.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.life.resume: There's more to it, aye! Where were we? I've lost my place entirely.
More, yes. Remind me where I stopped — I tell it in a different order each time.
There's a rest! Give me a moment to find the thread.
You remembered which part! Alright. Here's how it ended, then.
You had the right chapter. Remarkable. I'd have needed reminding myself.
You knew where I stopped! Right — no recap, straight to the end.
Where it leaves me! Huh. Better than it left me then, I think.
Now? Better! Not fixed, but better, and I'll take better.
It sits differently now. Nobody ever asks the 'now' question.
It was! And you asked. I'd not have volunteered it, %1$s.
Right, well. Consider the story shelved.
...Ha. Fine. I'll find a shorter one for next time.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.life.revisi: You asked me about my life and I've thought of SO many more bits since. Sit down.
...Maybe! But not today. Today I'm right.
Right, well. I'll be insufferable about it when I'm proved correct.
...Ha. We'll see. I've plenty of years to be right in.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.neighbour.m: We did! There was one winter we didn't, and it has never once been discussed since.
Well enough! We disagree about the fence and agree about everything that matters.
No. They wronged me, and I've been magnificently civil about it ever since.
There's a great deal more to them than the one story, and I've the time if you have!
Ask me! I'd much rather you had it from me than from whoever's holding court at the well.
Go on. I'll tell you everything that's mine to tell, and I'll enjoy the telling.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.neighbour.n: Then you'll be the first! And they'll pretend they never needed you to. Watch.
Go in the morning. They're proudest after dark, for reasons nobody has explained.
Good. Don't announce it — leave it by the door and say absolutely nothing.
I will! Coming from me it gets past the pride, which is the entire trick of it.
That's the wiser way round. They'd refuse you flat and accept me saying it.
Consider it said. Don't expect thanks — expect a nod, in about six months.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.neighbour.r: Better than the week before! Which is the most anyone can say about anyone, really.
Proud and cold, in that order. The cold will pass; the proud is permanent.
Asking that puts you ahead of everyone who asked about the firewood. Everyone.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.news.follow: Me? I'm — thank you. I'm alright. And YOU? You get to answer that too, %1$s.
I'm well! Which nobody has asked in a fortnight. Now you. Go on.
Fine, thank you. Your turn, and no wriggling out of it.
...Should they! No. That's how a village eats itself, %1$s.
Right, well. Consider that the last thing I tell you first.
...Ha. No. Some things get to stay small.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.news.glad.p: Do! This is the one kind of news that improves in the telling.
Pass it on! Good news is the only sort that gets better second-hand and I'd know.
Do. Tell everyone. Tell the miller twice — he'll enjoy it.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.news.glad.s: ...Must you! It was a lovely week and it lasted almost a whole minute.
Right! Cloud located. Thank you, %1$s. Very thorough.
...Ha. Fine. I'll be pleased about it privately.
...Firewood, and nobody to fetch it. That's the honest answer, unglamorous as it is.
Somebody to sit with them who isn't crying. You'd manage that, I think.
Nothing they'd ask for. Everything they'd take, if it were offered quietly enough.
So do I! It's a strange thing, watching people go, and this village does a lot of it.
Kind of you. Half the village is placing bets instead, which tells you about the village.
True enough. Whatever it is, I hope it works out splendidly.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.news.resume: Standing! Which at three weeks is genuinely the whole of what you can ask for.
Worse than last week and better than the week before. It goes in waves, apparently.
They asked after you, actually! I said you'd been asking after them.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.news.sad.am: ...No. Not that one. I make the jokes and even I wouldn't.
Get away from me. I mean it, %1$s.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.news.sad.co: ...Not well. Nobody is. Thank you for asking after them and not the details.
Badly, and I've no lightness for this one. Thank you for asking the right thing.
Not well. You asked about them. Most people ask about the story.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.news.teen.d: Too young! Right. Two more years of that and then I'll be too inexperienced. I've a calendar.
Everyone repeats it. Everyone. I'm simply the one who gets the lecture.
Fine! Go and ask somebody taller. I'll wait. It won't take long.
It's not repeating if it's TRUE! That's just news, and news is my favourite thing.
Right! I asked nobody and told everybody. That's not what happened, but fine.
...Ha. You asked. You did. I've witnesses.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.aff: Not this one. Two more words and you'd have had the whole picture.
Then go and spread that fine even-handedness somewhere it can do less damage.
I braced for that and it still got through. Impressive, in its way.
Long enough to stop counting. Which is a cheerful way of saying too long.
Since the frost. I've been very entertaining about it and told absolutely no one.
A while! Every day I decided to mention it tomorrow, and tomorrow kept turning up.
Not the ending. The middle, where I'm still talking and it isn't me talking.
That I'll do something unforgivable and be remembered for the one week of it.
Being handled gently. Everyone goes soft-voiced and I'd rather they shouted.
Frightened, and I've run out of jokes about it, which tells you where we are.
I've been better. I'd list the ways, but you look like you have somewhere to be.
Don't ask me that kindly, %1$s. Cheerfulness is all that's holding this together.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.ann: Still on about it! Yes. It's the best material I've had all week.
Right, well. I'll take my grievance somewhere it's appreciated.
...Ha. Give me another day and I'll be over it. Probably.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.ela: I'll get carried away if I like! It's my afternoon and I'm having it.
Right! Down we come. That was a very efficient landing, %1$s.
...Ha. Fine. I'll be delighted quietly in a corner.
The quiet bit at the end of the day, when I remember it's still true! That's the best of it.
The end of the day. All the shouting is fine, but the quiet bit is where it lands.
Remembering it at dusk and finding it hasn't gone. That's the part I'd keep.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.exp: They do! Alone, mostly, and now I know exactly why. Thank you for the demonstration.
And every one of them remembers who said it. You've joined a very short list.
Then I'll manage the conversation alone as well. I'm getting practice.
Frightened and delighted in the same hour. Nobody warns you about that bit!
Well enough. Better than my mother had it, and she reminded me of hers weekly.
Some mornings my boots win. The rest of it I'd not trade for a quiet house.
No! And apparently that's usual, which is the least comforting comfort I've had.
Ready as a house half-built. It'll have to finish itself around us, won't it.
I was ready in spring. Now I'm impatient, and impatient is much more fun.
Tired in a way I don't mind! Ask again on Friday and you may get a different answer.
Large. Magnificently, inconveniently large, and hungry at hours with no names.
Two of us in here and only one of us sleeps. I'll let you guess which, %1$s.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.fin: Since about the spring, if I'm honest! It crept. Very underhand of it.
Spring. It didn't arrive, it accumulated, which is a much sneakier way to go about things.
Six months, give or take. I've only just done the arithmetic and I'd rather not have.
...No. I'm not. Nobody's just said it, so I've been getting away with 'fine' for weeks.
No! And that's the first time anybody's made me say it. Well done, I suppose.
No, I'm not, and now I've said it out loud and there's no putting it back.
Mostly! There's a thing, but it's small and it'll keep. Very small. Barely a thing.
Mostly fine. One item outstanding, and it's not urgent enough to spoil an afternoon.
Mostly. There's something, and it's the sort of something that improves by being ignored.
You look like it, if you don't mind me saying! Which is a terrible thing to say and I've said it.
You do, rather. I'd not mention it if we weren't being honest with each other.
You look it. There. Now we've both been rude and we can get on.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.gri: ...No. There's no joke in here and I'd know.
Get away from me, %1$s. I've no lightness left for this.
...Go. I'll be someone else again tomorrow.
Ah. You heard, then. We lost one of our own. Thank you for asking, %1$s.
You heard. One of ours. There's no light way to say that and I've stopped looking for one.
We lost somebody. The gap is the size of the whole village. Thank you for coming by.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.gua: Right! Has the rain reached your end of the village, or is it hoarding it down here?
Very well. The new gate. Everyone has an opinion and I want yours immediately.
Easier. Where were you before here? And make it a good story, I've had a dull week.
Nothing that's yours yet! Try again in a year and I'll be delightful about it.
Second time today. Same answer, and I'm enjoying it considerably less.
No. You had the polite version, you spent it, and there isn't a third.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.hur: A scratch! Marvellous. Come back when your eyes work and we'll talk again.
It's my scratch and I've grown fond of it, so mind how you speak about it.
Right. I'll be sure to bleed more entertainingly for you next time.
Then I'll still be here, and considerably less pleasant about it. Come anyway!
You'd best, because I'll not send for anyone myself. I never do, on principle.
That's the useful sort of kindness. Everyone offers sympathy; nobody comes back.
Something came out of the dark faster than I did. It won, and it knows it won.
My own fault entirely. I was told not to go and I went with real commitment.
A fall! A magnificent one. No audience, which is the only mercy in it.
Been better! Took a bad one two nights back and it's still making its opinions known.
Sore, and doing a heroic job of not mentioning it. Until now, obviously.
In myself? Excellent. The rest of me is staging a small rebellion, %1$s.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.pro: It wasn't nothing to me! But fine, consider it forgotten with great enthusiasm.
Then the next one stays in my head, where it will be admired by me alone.
Twice today somebody has corrected my own feelings. It's becoming a hobby of theirs.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.noticed.wor: I have been getting on with it! Tirelessly. That is, in fact, the entire problem.
Right. Which is why the last four people got a cheerful 'fine' and went away happy.
Then I'll be tired somewhere else, where the company is worse but quieter.
A whole day! I'd not know what to do with one, but I intend to find out.
You mean that, don't you. Nobody has offered, and I'd entirely stopped expecting it.
Then I'll take it, and I'll not spend it usefully, and that is precisely the point.
Since spring! I noticed in autumn, which shows what a keen self-observer I am.
Long enough that I've stopped calling it a bad patch and started calling it a wing.
Couldn't tell you. There was no first day. It simply declined to stop.
Tired. Not the sleep-fixes-it kind, so don't waste a good suggestion on me.
Worn through! Nothing's wrong, which is somehow the annoying part.
I've been better, and I can't point at one thing, which spoils the story entirely.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.empa: Exhausting! You've no idea. They cross the lane when they see me coming.
It wears. Nobody says a word — they simply develop urgent business elsewhere.
Tiring. And the joke is I'd do the same in their place, which spoils the complaint.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.enco: Ah — no. Two minutes and a solution. Very impressive, %1$s.
Right, stop there. That knot took eleven years to tie.
...I could! I've thought about it. Hearing somebody else say it shrinks it considerably.
Talking. It's the obvious thing and the hardest one, which is very inconvenient.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.firs: I LOVE them! Every single one! Even the grumpy ones — ESPECIALLY the grumpy ones, they're just soft on the inside!
Best neighbors ever! We wave, we borrow, we bicker, we make up by supper! That's a village, %1$s! I adore it!
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.foll: ...No! I've been avoiding it for a whole season. Maybe I should, at that.
Talking! There's a thought. Everyone here would rather keep a good grudge.
You make it sound simple. It might even be, which is annoying.
...No! I've already said far too much and I'm enjoying it far too little.
Right, that's my lot. I've a reputation to fail to maintain, %1$s.
...Ha. No. Ask them yourself and see how far you get.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.fond: The baker! And I'll deny it absolutely if it gets back to the miller.
The baker. Don't tell the miller. Actually, do — I'd enjoy watching that.
The baker, obviously. Everyone says the miller and everyone is wrong.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.goss: Then here it is! The miller's brother has been counting my firewood. COUNTING it.
Right. The miller's brother. My woodpile. He thinks I haven't noticed.
Since you'll keep it — the miller's brother has developed a professional interest in my logs.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.resp: You want the specifics! Alright — but this stays here, on pain of never hearing anything again.
Specifics, then! And if this comes back to me I shall be extremely disappointed and very loud.
Right. One example. It stays with you or I'm finished telling you things.
You've lived here five minutes, %1$s! Give it a year and ask me again.
Right! Confident, aren't we. Come back after a winter.
...Ha. Bold from somebody who's met them twice.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.resu: Less than I'd planned! The planned version was a speech, and speeches mend nothing.
That I'd been unfair. Two words of it were true and the rest was scaffolding.
Nothing clever at all. 'I've been avoiding you.' More use than a year of thinking.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.shy/: They're... a lot! Kind, but a lot. I like them best from my window, waving.
Kind and extremely loud. I'm fond of them in doses of about ten minutes.
A lot. Wonderful people. Wonderful in the way weather is wonderful.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.people.youn: That's a horrible thing to say! And you're normally quite good fun, %1$s.
Right, no. Even I wouldn't, and I say most things.
...Ha. No. That one isn't funny from any angle.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.regrets.clo: You didn't owe me that! It does help. It helps considerably more than forgiving would have.
You gave me one back. Now we're both slightly worse people and I feel much better.
Right. That helps. I did not expect it to and it does.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.regrets.fol: You don't! Nobody's said that. I'm not sure I believe it, but I'll keep it anyway.
Right. Said out loud. I'd not have predicted that as this evening's development.
Nobody's ever said that to me. I'm going to be strange about it for a week.
That's better! Absolution I'd not have trusted. This I do, oddly.
Right — you didn't try to fix it. Everyone tries to fix it. It's exhausting.
Sitting with it. Splendid. Nobody offers that; they all bring a toolkit.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.regrets.for: You don't get to decide that! ...And yet something just came loose. How annoying.
That isn't yours to give. It worked regardless. I'd like a word with my own head.
Kind! It doesn't reach the part of me that decides these things, mind.
Kindly meant. It's stopped about a foot short of where it needed to land.
Ah — no. Kind of you, and entirely outside your jurisdiction.
Right, stop. You weren't there, %1$s. It's not yours to hand out.
You don't. Hm! I'll keep it and see whether it holds by morning.
Right — I'll take it. Provisionally. With a receipt.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.regrets.res: ...Ah, no. You've gone straight past the door I opened, %1$s.
Right! That's not on offer. Lovely try, though.
...Ha. No. I gave you an inch and you've measured the room.
It has, a little! You told me I wasn't a bad person and it stuck. Annoyingly.
Some. What you said stayed. I'd expected it to wear off by Tuesday.
A little! Your sentence has outlasted several of mine.
A little! You didn't tell me it was fine, which is why I believed the rest of it.
Some. You listened rather than ruling on it. Refreshingly restrained of you.
A little. Nobody fixed anything and somehow that's what let it shift.
A little! Time does some of it. Being asked after does the rest, apparently.
Some. Mostly time. But the asking counts, and nobody asks.
A little. It moves at the speed of a glacier and a glacier does get there.
I have, since you asked last! Thinking's most of the way there. Allegedly.
I've thought about it. Extensively. Thinking is my finest skill and my worst habit.
Since you asked, yes! I've got as far as thinking and no further, which is very me.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.rumors.doub: ...You're right! And I've been telling it all week without once asking myself that.
I'll hold it, then, and see whether it turns up from anybody else. How novel.
That's the sensible line. It's also the one absolutely nobody here draws.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.rumors.more: Ask me properly! You'll get a far straighter answer than the telling was, I promise.
There's what's said and there's what I think, and the second is much better company.
Go on, ask. I'd infinitely rather be questioned about it than quoted on it.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.rumors.priv: Them! Not the story. Do you know how rare that is? Four people this week and not one.
Badly, and privately. I'll not decorate it and I'll not make a joke of it either.
That's the right question. I'll tell them somebody asked. They'll want to know that.
No. There's no lighter way to hold this one and I'm not going to find one for you.
That's exactly why I didn't say it. Ask the family. I'll not be the shortcut.
I said as much as I'm willing to. That was the whole speech and it had an ending.
Good! That's the whole of what I wanted out of telling you, and I feel better already.
Then I was right about you — I'd been about eighty per cent sure, which is high for me.
Thank you. I'll know by Thursday whether that was true, and I fully expect it will be.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.scene.villa: So — %2$s! And I have absolutely no idea how I feel about it, which is new for me.
We have had %2$s and I keep opening my mouth about it and closing it again. Very unlike me.
%2$s, and everyone is being terribly casual, and I am not managing casual at all.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.season.todd: They're NOT! They're the best ones and I've counted.
They ARE special. You're just not looking properly!
...I'll show you tomorrow and then you'll see.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.season.turn: Is it! Then why ask, %1$s. You've saved us both a conversation.
Right, well. Nothing changes and I'm delighted to have confirmed it.
...Ha. Same as always. Except it isn't, but never mind.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.secret.clos: You'd trade! Right. Now we've each got a rope round the other's ankle, and that's exactly right.
A trade! Excellent. Mutually assured silence. The finest kind of friendship.
Yours for mine. Now neither of us can say a word, and I find that enormously restful.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.secret.foll: ...That's all it was! To you. To me it was the whole of last year.
Right, well. Filed under nothing. Excellent.
...Ha. Fine. I'll keep the big ones and give you the weather.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.secret.resp: Alright! The 'famous' pie I bring to every festival? The trader sells them. By the dozen.
Right — here it is. Brace yourself. It's extremely mundane and extremely mortifying.
Fine! You've got it. I feel lighter and considerably more exposed.
Because you've never repeated a thing I've said! I've been counting. Obsessively.
Because you don't carry things to the square. Do you know how few people manage that?
You've never once passed anything on. I keep a tally. It's a very short list.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.secret.resu: You asked after me, not the secret! You always were the right person for this.
Me first, again! That's twice. Twice is officially a pattern and I'm delighted.
Right — still the right person. I'd chosen well and I'm insufferable about it.
You asked after ME, not the secret! Nobody does that. Nobody!
Me, not it. Right. Everyone else opens with 'so, has anyone...' — every time.
You asked about me first. I'm going to think about that all afternoon.
You wouldn't promise, and you've kept it anyway! That says more than the promise would have.
No promise, no leak. That's the good kind of person and there are about four of them.
You refused to swear to it and then you did it. Delightful. Infuriating. Delightful.
You gave your word and you've kept it! I checked, in my way. Thoroughly.
Word given, word kept. I ran a small and entirely unnecessary investigation.
You said you would and you did! Extraordinary. Nobody does both.
It's still between us, then! Good. Excellent. Wonderful.
Still ours. Right. I shall stop checking the square for a fortnight.
Nothing has moved! That is genuinely the best news I've had this week.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.standing.ba: A lecture! Right. I'll shorten it to three words next time, %1$s.
Well, that's my civic duty discharged and unappreciated.
...Ha. Fine. Next time it's just 'fine' and you can work out the rest.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.standing.in: A lecture! Right. I'll shorten it to three words next time, %1$s.
Well, that's my civic duty discharged and unappreciated.
...Ha. Fine. Next time it's just 'fine' and you can work out the rest.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.standing.mi: That's exactly why I gave you both! A comfortable answer would have cost you a year.
Then you'll get the truth from me every time, which not everybody enjoys.
Good! The ones who only want the warm half never mend a single thing.
That's the work, and it's slow! Years, not weeks, and not one thank you along the way.
Then start with the ones who won't look at you. The rest are followers, all of them.
It can be done! I've watched it done twice here, and both took a great deal of patience.
The forgiving one! Took me a while, mind, and I'm not proud of the while.
Neither, and I'm enjoying the suspense far more than I ought to be.
Yours, obviously. Why else would I be stood here telling you the awkward part?
peppy.dialogue.conversations.standing.ne: You ask questions nobody else asks! I've not decided if that's good yet. It's certainly novel.
You're an unknown quantity and I'm enjoying not knowing, which is unusual for me.
Undecided! Which from me is practically a compliment, %1$s.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.standing.tr: You want it honest? There's a matter people haven't let go of. It sits between you and this place.
Honestly? Something's still doing the rounds, and it isn't a flattering something.
There's a matter. Nobody's dropped it. I'd rather tell you than let you find out at the inn.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.standing.un: Steady, and better company than the last three who asked me that question!
Hard to read and easy to like — an odd pair, but I've enjoyed working it out.
You listen longer than you talk, %1$s, which makes you my favourite kind of person.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet: You did! Not anything you said. Just that you stayed, which nobody does.
You stayed when it stopped being an easy conversation. That's the whole of it.
It wasn't a thing you said! It was the not-leaving. Very underrated skill.
...You don't remember it! Wonderful. It was a whole afternoon, %1$s.
Right, well. I'll keep the memory. It's a good one and it's mine now.
...Ha. Fine. I'll describe it to you sometime and watch you not recall a bit of it.
You want the story of how we met? Go on, then. I'll tell it my way and my way is better.
Right! The story. Sit down, because I've been waiting to tell this properly for ages.
The story! Excellent. I warn you now that I come out of it rather well.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.us.future.n: Work it out! That's better than one of us just giving in, which is the usual method.
Right — both of us. I'd rather that than a winner and a quiet resentment.
Neither of us surrenders! Excellent. Harder, longer, and infinitely better.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.us.future.p: That's fair! I'd rather that than a promise you'd resent by spring.
No promise. Good. Kind promises are the ones that rot fastest.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.us.future.r: ...Never! Well. That's admirably decisive of you, %1$s.
Right. Never. I'll cross the whole page out, then.
...Ha. Fine. I did ask, and I got a very clear answer.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.as: You want to know! Right. Small things — and you asking is one of them, so that's one solved.
You asked! Nobody asks when things are fine. It's the fine times that quietly go wrong.
Right — there's a list. It's short. It's mostly about washing-up.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.di: ...I asked you a serious question, %1$s! One a year, and you've spent it.
Right, well. Back to the weather, then.
...Ha. Fine. I'll be serious at somebody else.

...Twenty! Said out loud it's a decision rather than a daydream, isn't it.
The weaver would have something to say. She can say it to my face, then.
Every one of them! Which makes the good years better and the bad ones a great deal worse.
A smaller flock. Forty means numbers and twenty means names, and I know which I'd rather have.
Sheep! They have one idea a day and defend it to the death. I admire the commitment.
I keep the flock. They don't gossip. Much. Certainly less than the square does.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.work.prof.t: Twenty years of the same nine tools coming back. Anyone would learn to read them. It still feels like a trick.
Ash, seasoned two years, and absolutely no varnish. Varnish is a lie you can feel through your palm!
...One! I've been asking for a month when what I needed was an afternoon.
And give it to the farm that blunts nine a season. Now that is a proper test.
A better handle! Two degrees. Everyone says it's nonsense. Nine blunt hoes a season say otherwise.
Sets of small tools for the children. Fourteen children, four tools each — I've costed it twice.
Shovels, hoes, picks — the unglamorous things that build everything. Somebody has to make the quiet heroes.
I make tools! Nobody ever writes a song about a hoe and yet here we all are, eating.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.work.prof.v: Forty people's ordinary days, written badly, over nineteen years. Somehow that adds up to expertise.
Nine of the ten things a frightened person names, I am not. The tenth is extremely dull.
...With his! Sealed, unread, four valleys from anybody who'd know a name in them.
You've solved nineteen years in one sentence and I need to sit down about it.
A young one who did everything right and was driven out anyway. I keep the notes. Cheerful trade, mine.
Four letters I'd like kept somewhere safe. Sealed. Unread. Preferably four valleys from anybody.
I consult on nocturnal affairs. Professionally. My clientele tips well and never comes by at noon.
Night work, obviously. Shutters, hours, and a headache if I misjudge the season. Manageable.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.work.prof.w: Four years of being shouted at for looking away. It worked, unfortunately, which ruins my whole complaint.
Steel has opinions and the fire changes them temporarily. Best sentence I own, and I did not steal it.
...One selfish thing! I've never thought of it in those terms and it changes everything.
Earned — ha! Say that again in front of the mayor and see what it costs me.
Three times! Two left angry, one thanked me a year later. That's a better rate than I expected.
A year of ploughs. Same fire, same steel, no awkward questions. It sounds like a holiday.
Blades are honest tools. They only ever do what the hand asks, which is the interesting problem.
I forge. Hot, loud, and every so often a thing leaves this shop that I'm quietly delighted with.
Everything written about people like me is about what we are. Nothing at all is about Tuesday.
Eleven years of trial and error and one very good cellar door. That's the curriculum.
...Name him in it! He couldn't refuse, he'd hate it, and he'd read it forty times.
That's payment he can't hand back. Eleven years and I never once thought of one.
Eleven days! Everything between now and then is preparation for three hours. Excellent ratio.
The arrangements, written down. Everything published about people like me is about what we are, not about Tuesday.
I consult on the moon-touched. Three days a month I'm unavailable and everyone has learned not to ask.
Moon business. Excellent job, terrible hours, and a calendar that argues with everyone else's.
Guessing what a plank will do in ten years is a strange thing to be good at, and I am good at it.
Knuckles rapped for every thick shaving. I have a thin shaving and a lasting resentment to show for it.
...Call it a commission! That's how anything gets built in this place, isn't it.
She'd never ask and she'd use it every day. That settles the argument I was having.
Every time! The tavern bar was a spiteful old oak on the north slope and I have not forgiven it.
A staircase. A proper turned one. Nobody needs it, which is exactly why I want it.
Trees give a lifetime of patience in every plank. I try to build things worthy of the wait.
I make things out of trees! Doors, tables, one very ambitious staircase I have not started.
peppy.dialogue.conversations.work.respon: Because somebody has to, and because it's mine! That's most of it and it's enough.
Because it needs doing and I'm here. Those two facts have made my whole life.
Because it's mine. Everything else is decoration on that one word.
It is to me! And I'm the one doing it, so I win.
Right! Boring. Come and try it and then we'll talk, %1$s.
peppy.dialogue.conversations/1: A real conversation?! %1$s, this just cracked the top three of my whole day! Okay okay — ask me ANYTHING!
peppy.dialogue.conversations/2: A LONG one?! %1$s, I am going to be unbearable about this. Sit down!
peppy.dialogue.conversations/3: Ooh a chat! Best decision you've made all day and it's not even close! Go!
